sources.title: Art B. Owen and Daniel Rudolf, A strong law of large numbers for scrambled net integration (2020)
sources.locator: Complete arXiv v3 PDF. Read Section 2, especially the QMC definitions and Lemma 1 proof that finite Hardy–Krause variation implies Riemann integrability. The source proves this by decomposing into completely monotone functions and invoking bounded-monotone Riemann integrability; the new carrier instead proves the result directly from finite-grid variation and coordinatewise monotone functions.
